notes.title: Chaos Battle v1.3.0 update description!
notes.content:
A month later, the new version of the game mode has been updated it! Thank you all for waiting and supporting this month. In the new version made some changes:
1. Add game mode: Raiders!
2. Add more than 200 kinds of head features, including hair, beard, mask!
3. Improve the game frame, so play more smoothly!
4. Repair known some BUG!
Tip: In the new mode, the occupation progress bar will be based on the number of players in both sides of the range!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30759644/acfc2b0a83c2c89e47261f80f87c11bfc650b5f4.jpg

notes.title: Chaos Battle Release Notes
notes.content:
Thank you for your support, chaos fighting new model (fame) update!
This update includes:
1. Add game mode 2: fame.(Start armed your army!)
2 modify the game mode 1 in the BUG.
3. Add a variety of game sound!
Add a watchtower in mode 1!
5 players will fall after the death of equipment!
6. Increase the response of blood bottles!
7. Increase blood bottle price!
8.Increase the importance of character level！
Other minor updates.

notes.content:

2. Update landscaping in the first episode of individual scenes.
3 added the first battlefield watch station, you can see all the players and the specific direction of the store!
4. Update the first battle in the Bug!

notes.title: Chaos Battle Significant updates
notes.content:
In view of the user feedback, decided to do some updates:
1. Remove the rigidity system.
2. Add a variety of weapons attack speed.
The above changes will enhance the fun and pleasure of the game, welcome to download experience.
Thank you for the advice of the players.ːsteamhappyː
